title: data-driven-customer-intake-scorer-with-runway-visibility
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build a reproducible, explainable intake scoring service that ranks incoming customer requests against roadmap capacity (runway) and SLA/commitment risk. The scorer should combine account signals (MRR, renewal date, strategic flag), product impact (feature surface overlap), technical cost estimate (eng effort, infra implications), and risk to existing SLOs. Output is a per-request score and a suggested delivery window (next-cycle / 1-cycle / multi-cycle) with justification text to surface in intake UI and to downstream roadmap planners.
proposal: Phase 1: Implement deterministic heuristic scorer using weighted signals and a small policy engine. Phase 2: Add ML ranking model trained on historical intake + outcome labels (accepted, delayed, cancelled). Phase 3: Integrate runway visibility by correlating capacity forecasts (sprint points and committed initiatives) to automatically compute suggested delivery windows and soft-deadlines. Provide an audit trail and explanation strings for each signal contribution.
acceptance_criteria: Heuristic scorer implemented and exposed as an internal REST endpoint returning score(0-100), top-3 contributing signals, and suggested delivery window
Score explanations and signal breakdown are stored in audit logs and shown in a preview UI mock in the intake console
Integration with capacity forecast: for two sample lines-of-business, suggested windows reflect projected capacity and mark requests as over-capacity when necessary
Unit tests for scoring logic and end-to-end test for ingestion -> score -> UI display
Stakeholder review (PM + Eng + Design) signoff on weights and default thresholds
